errorInterpretation: Repeated F9 requests were rejected after the first successful capture; valid phase data is retained.
boundaries: Normal manual timing precedes F9 and is the sustained-rate evidence.
Automatic and manual phases differ in camera, tick and evolving actors; they are not a matched A/B.
All samples report HD 4X; the subjective Original control was not captured here.
Instrumented rate is not Normal FPS. CPU sample weights are approximate and may include native waits.
Inclusive function weights overlap; recursive frames are counted once per normalized location.
Trace callbacks are joined to CPU samples by timestamps, not guessed matches to phase row durations.
conclusions: Normal manual sample is 21.35 mean loop FPS, not a display-present counter. All 320 intervals exceed 33 ms.
Normal manual graphics median is 36.855 ms; simulation median is 4.680 ms. Sustained load is captured before profiling.
Frame callbacks use approximately 50.953 ms wall and 49.917 ms thread CPU in the instrumented sample; sustained renderer-thread CPU work dominates this trace.
No shader compile/link or initial texImage2D occurs in the manual trace. Further loading precompile does not address this measured sustained interval.
World matrix traversal, draw setup/attribute binding and uniform submission are measured hot paths. They do not identify GPU execution time.

The identity octree wrapper forces child world matrices on each explicit world pass. A copied immutable Mac one-variable control validates identical stored world matrices with about 60 percent fewer matrix products; C8 changes this wrapper only. Windows gain remains unmeasured.
No new application-side 60 FPS cap is established. External presentation behavior and actual process VRAM remain unmeasured.

copiedMacControl.boundary: Copied immutable C7 Mac runtime; change only the static octree root matrixAutoUpdate flag in memory. Frozen controls are not gameplay FPS.
